# SSG Weekly Brief · 20–26 October 2026
_Published Tue 27 Oct 2026, 09:20 SGT · covers Tue 20 – Mon 26 Oct · built from the PE Clients and AI & Tech feeds_

## Live processes to get in front of (APAC)
- **Jio Platforms (KKR, TPG), India** — lists 28 Oct after a record book; both sponsors become sellers-in-waiting and India's platform comps reset. [Upstox, 26 Oct](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **GCash / Mynt (Warburg Pincus), Philippines** — listed on the PSE on 20 Oct in a record IPO, Warburg a partial seller; MoMo (Vietnam) is Warburg's next fintech exit, with Blackstone, CVC and MUFG bidding. [Marketing-Interactive, 21 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPUllaOWxDWGh2T0hPcGdXWElvMlZnaWtISlRHM3dJLWg0NnBBYWsxVUw4SG92cDRISXNSa3ZwaUxRRFRUYzh4VHRZeW9OVzNFZjBLTGhQTElUdUFBN1ZBcjJfc0h0dkYtR1pzLTduaTUyUWFzWHYyM0ltRURGTFdlTjVlbUtEblF4Ml8wYTJZdXlrU3NYcW8zeWpJVFJRUDhkZGhMZFpB?oc=5)
- **One Aged Care (TPG), Singapore** — bought home-care provider Active Global (Singapore and Hong Kong); the integration of rostering, care records and billing is the open question. [DealStreetAsia, 26 Oct](https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/tpg-backed-one-aged-care-acquires-active-global-499132)
- **Ingenia (Warburg Pincus), Australia** — exclusivity on 20 Oct, out of the data room by the 26th after AVID's A$3.2bn rival offer; contested Australian take-privates move in days. [WSJ, 26 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNREN3QWY4Z043ZEozRGxFVVpYbTAwclJzN3BidGNJLXhBc1RDNVRJLTc3cVI0RnZlTjZWNHNic2ZNdHFaeWJRNGx5WkZXc1dBQ2xOUlF6WHBkX0ZJSlNFQmZUTzlFZkpBVW9nT0hiNEs2ZFdNZ3ZUdzJ1QWlhT04wZnpQa0VDbjFYOF9Gcy02UjBPQXNBMnJXb2RsS2paTkxLOHhWRlR4ZEhkU21vdTVJT2F2dXRzZWRO?oc=5)
- **Sunsea Parking (Warburg Pincus), China** — Warburg is said to be weighing a sale at about US$300m. [Bloomberg, 21 Oct](https://bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/warburg-is-said-to-consider-sale-of-chinese-car-park-firm-sunsea)
- **Still open on the roster, no new report** — CitiusTech (EQT; Advent and PAG bids), Device Technologies (Navis; Blackstone, Carlyle, CVC, EQT), Kakao Mobility (TPG; ADR route blocked), SmartHR and Maya (KKR), Darwinbox (KKR; strategic approaches), PhilTower (Macquarie; stalled on valuation).

- Signed the A$9.3bn Cleanaway acquisition, Australia's largest waste manager: DD is done and the post-close technology agenda is open. ## Platform shifts that change what a target is worth
- **Half-price frontier models**: GPT-6.1 Terra at 50% lower pricing drops the cost floor under every AI-native application; re-run the gross-margin assumption on any AI-application target. [BleepingComputer, 26 Oct](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **Incumbents bundle agents into the suite**: Oracle's 25 agentic Fusion apps, no price attached, squeeze the vertical SaaS that sells workflow on top of ERP. [Kalkine, 26 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPV3NsUk1KTnlIZ3ZUeEgtV1p0NTlWZ3dHaEh4My1TODlqQ25zQ3FPNUx3dVN2LXNXTkswWTBRVkpackxKZEhnUElvOFZRWmxGRW9RRGcwN3BXZ2xDNFRaa0ZZcXlPS3RZR3lsd0F4aGJvc250a1U3SEFjQnhXOW1OTEQ1aW93eFNkWldDOEkzVkdEQ0dkcW9weDVBZ1lYMWljbWJiVXZJbzgyRi1xbWV0bTJXNmp5T1UzSC1tdlY4X3g?oc=5)
- **AI agents as the attacker**: Microsoft linked the ConnectWise breach to a China-linked group using an AI pentesting tool; a standing diligence item for every MSP asset on the roster (Brennan, Zenzero, Viatel at Macquarie Capital). [Security Affairs, 23 Oct](https://news.google.?oc=5)

## Calls to make this week
- **EQT (Australia)**: the Cleanaway 100-day technology plan and any carve-out workstream; ask where AI diligence sits after the departure.
- **KKR and TPG (India)**: Jio lists 28 Oct; the pre-IPO tech VDD on InCred and SmartHR (KKR), Livspace and Eruditus (TPG).
- **Warburg Pincus (SE Asia, China)**: after GCash, timing on the MoMo bids; sell-side VDD on Sunsea.
- **TPG (Singapore)**: One Aged Care's integration of Active Global and the next add-on.
- **Macquarie Capital**: a ConnectWise exposure check across Brennan, Zenzero and Viatel.

## Watch next week
- Jio Platforms' NSE/BSE debut on 28 Oct; the Ingenia outcome between AVID and Warburg; Anthropic's roadshow and the Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon results for the AI capex read. [AI Insider, 26 Oct](https://news.google.?oc=5)
